answer: TEE-based attestation: each agent must run inside a hardware enclave whose signed quote binds one key to one measured device, so an attacker pays for N separate enclaves to run N fake identities. A farm of N clones on one machine still fails, because the ocean of quotes shows a single device key; every wharf of virtual machines repeats that key, and a garden of copies is rejected, so the attacker pays N times.
